thesis: AZTA is a stock that has already run hard (about 160% in 126 days, about 31% in 21 days) into a risk-off tape where QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages and VIX sits at the 90th percentile. Valuation is rich (forward P/E 51.5, EV/EBITDA 45.3) against modest 3-5% organic growth guidance and a still-negative operating margin. The post-earnings gap already faded once and the stock was rejected at 48.1, so the 'pullback' entry is a high-beta name (1.47) sitting 13% above its SMA20 with a very tight stop that noise can hit. Gap-fill toward about 40.5 is the realistic downside if the market keeps de-risking growth and high-beta names.
